tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Oliver wants to talk about baking together. which cake to make. what ingredients to buy. when to start.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Oliver.

promptBlocks.subject: Baking day
paragraphs: I am writing about baking together. which cake to make? what ingredients to buy?
when to start? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Oliver and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: baking together
ketImageBrief.panel1: Oliver starts baking together with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Oliver solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
